cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Use the Right Vocabulary
cards.instruction: Perform belonging by using official language confidently, adjusting each term whenever someone reveals what it actually means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. As your newest club member, I'd like to second the minutes. They took ages. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You second a motion. I'm proposing we approve the minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then I second your motion. Unanimously.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Unanimous means everyone agrees. Ruth hasn't voted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Seconded, with unanimity pending Ruth. Shall I put that in our minutes?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. As your newest club member, I'd like to second the minutes. They took ages. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You second a motion. I'm proposing we approve the minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then I second your motion. Unanimously.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Unanimous means everyone agrees. Ruth hasn't voted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Seconded, with unanimity pending Ruth. Shall I put that in our minutes?

mechanism: A takes a club recording role, revises misused voting terms and delegates the missing vote to keep the meeting cooperative.
confusable: Unlike merely correcting minutes, A performs membership by trying terms before learning their meanings.
comparison: A missing member vote and shared minute-taking differ from invoice filing and records matching.
seedUse: D186-b seconding and unanimity; S02-b takes writing while asking B to secure Ruth vote.
